context:
Source: DataFrame query parity proposal v3 (item T11). Hypothesis only; SF=1 reproduction needs explicit approval. Project owner does NOT accept earlier reviewers' TPC-H claims.

Findings 2026-10-01: the hypothesis (loader or projection returns None) is wrong. (a) At SF 0.01-0.1 Q21, Q62 and Q99 do not diverge; they diverge only at SF=1. (b) TESTED: generating only the warehouse table with the bundled dsdgen: SF=0.1 has 1 warehouse with no NULLs; SF=1 has 5 warehouses and warehouse 5 has NULL w_warehouse_name and NULL sq_ft. So None is the data. (c) Causes at SF=1: expression sorts NULLs first (reference sorts last) in Q21, Q62, Q66, Q99; pandas drops the NULL group (Q66 5 vs 4 rows, Q99 90 vs 72) and leaks NaN. (d) A third bug found by a unit test: Q66 expression divided every row by col(w_warehouse_sq_ft).first(), the first group's value, which is wrong whenever there is more than one warehouse.

Progress: fixed and published as PR #2506 (branch fix/tpcds-warehouse-null-order, worktree ../BenchBox.wt-tpcds-warehouse-null, head eaaa4843b), held, auto-merge withheld; make pr-preflight exit 0 on that head. Evidence: 8 new unit cases (two warehouses, one NULL name; both families; Q21, Q62, Q66, Q99) all fail without the change and pass with it; full probe at SF 0.1 unchanged (no cell changed, expected since there is no NULL warehouse there); staged gate at 0.01 unchanged (146/198, 52 empty, 0 divergent). NOT done: the acceptance wording asks for a match at SF=0.1, but Q21, Q62 and Q99 already matched there and Q66 still diverges at SF 0.03-0.1 on both families with a large value mismatch (SF 0.1: 8288141.53 vs 238632.13 at column 8; cause not diagnosed, parameter drift is a candidate and not tested). Confirming the four queries at SF=1 needs explicit approval for an SF=1 run. Remaining: hosted CI, maintainer merge, SF=1 confirmation if approved, a decision on whether to track the Q66 value mismatch, then finish.
